## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format .` pass
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] Ran `uv run pytest -m eval` if this touches the triage prompt, output schema, or judge criteria
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` / `CLAUDE.md`) if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] No instance-specific data (repo watch lists, credentials, real emails) in the diff
